status: clear independent read-only production review; no blocker within explicit serialized/pure-borrowed contracts
method: Read-only source, primary installed prototype, producer test/recipe and bound artifact/log inspection. No reviewer builds, test execution, canonical changes, device actions or additional original-game analysis.

producer_gates.assertion_count_note: Includes register/byte comparisons, not independent scenarios

primary_prototype_evidence.scope: Exact seven public names, pointer-output/parent argument positions, uint32 Result zero and void teardown signatures only. Reference static objects, no-op teardown and guessed layouts/defaults are not adopted.

review: Owner stores only copied numeric configuration/identities/generations, counters and reference tokens. No CPU, Process, output guard, cancellation callback/context or native surface pointer is retained.

Creation copies configuration before clearing valid output, validates bounded fields, reserves an available owner slot and allocates before invoking the real one-way Process claim. Failure before claim does not burn it; after successful claim only nonfallible fixed-field publication remains. Live duplicate reservations are rejected; Process claim prevents namespace reuse after owner destruction.

Per-execute monotonic deadline is freshly computed after the cumulative event admission. Initial clock failure/overflow, final failure/expiry and both cancellation checkpoints precede LR/output/semantic publication. Idle lifetime is not a deadline; the independent cumulative event cap still bounds repeated zero-instruction traps.

Five operations maintain one Display/Layer/Native chain with monotonic16-byte identities,256 issuance limit and32 retained references. Duplicate, stale or wrong-parent identity requests stop; repeated native lookup returns the same live identity. No dimensions/defaults/retail object bytes or fabricated failure nn::Result is emitted.

Before output, full8-byte writable mapping, physical disjointness from the entire reserved backing and required protected-range guard are checked. LR is validated/set before atomic writev. Write failure restores trap PC before returning; fixed semantic metadata and X0 success commit only after write. Void teardown validates LR before metadata changes and preserves X0. Under stopped-CPU exclusivity no fallible callback/allocation occurs after guest output commit; unexpected register/rollback failure is explicit INTERNAL, not an ordinary refusal.

Detach forbids new active-surface operations/retains but leaves matching destruction and reference release possible. Retiring rejects execution and preserves owner until references drain. Release/stats/try_destroy are CPU-free; joint tests destroy the entire Process before releasing the final Window-style reference.

Resolver copies at most8 module descriptors and requires three core definitions. Existing GuestSymbols validates bounded geometry/null metadata, exact global/weak function names/default-or-protected visibility and complete declared text span. Imports do not activate methods; duplicate definitions and cross-operation address aliases refuse. Local results publish atomically after final cancellation/deadline check.

Adapter selects only exact entry PC, requires supplied BREAKPOINT reason, re-observes same current PC via zero-budget CPU run and checks executable4-byte mapping, then reads X0/X1/X30 before owner entry. NOT_OURS and adapter preflight failures preserve result/state. It executes no original body, modifies no code and leaves merging with existing breakpoint owners to the caller.

Global try-gate rejects owner reentry; borrowed guard/validation/cancellation callbacks are pure, nonmutating and prompt. The only state-changing callback is the explicit constructor claim. Reservation validation is the previously reviewed real Process contract, not failed-read inference.

Producer original tests exercise actual BLR-to-breakpoint dispatch, full GPR/output rollback, LR failure, writev failure after provisional return PC, foreign physical alias/provenance checks, constructor allocation before claim, first/last argument-read failures, generation/ref limits, expiry and hours-long idle gaps. Joint tests use real staged Process reservation/claim and CPU-free final release.

Recipes bind private CPU/GuestSymbols inputs and all final source/build artifacts, segregate test-only allocation/clock/write/read seams, and verify exact11 iOS exports. New archive contains only owner/adapter, preserving existing NVN composite dependencies.

nonblocking_documentation_observation.issue: Historical Final proposed C contract section still lists preimplementation create/resolver signatures. README and headers state the real implemented contract.
nonblocking_documentation_observation.resolution: Owner acknowledged and will correct only the separate repository-ready overlay, retaining this immutable producer checkpoint. No production change or new gate required for that documentation correction.

contract_limits: Fresh stop/source tables and actual attached surface epoch are trusted caller inputs; numeric structs are not cryptographic provenance. Caller must supply verified module metadata, merge bounded breakpoint registrations and keep Process/CPU/borrowed inputs alive and exclusive throughout dispatch.

Deadlines are cooperative and cannot preempt arbitrary blocking callbacks. Retain/release are fixed bounded host ownership operations; caller serialization and pure prompt borrowed callbacks remain required.

Only semantic owner state and guest bytes/registers/PC are rollback guarantees on ordinary refusal; lifetime attempt counters intentionally advance. INTERNAL denotes violated invariants and does not claim rollback.
No VI Binder service, retail display object layout, NVN Window/Acquire/Present, original invocation or displayed game-frame compatibility is established.
